description: Timed send-off tips Grady bellows after a new clone accepts the First Hour quest. Flag-gated to play once.

l1.text: Grady bellows after you: "That bat does nothing in your bag, sprat — EQUIP it! Then ATTACK whatever's ugliest. Simple as breathing."

l2.text: Grady cups his hands: "Two ways to swing! ATTACK all day long, or POWER for one that actually hurts — but a power swing leaves you wide open and slow to come back. Pick your moment."

l3.text: Grady, louder: "And when it winds up on YOU — DODGE! Costs you a beat, saves you a rib. Nobody out there fights fair, so neither do you."

l4.text: Grady, further off: "It gets dark out there, and the dark's killed more fresh ones than teeth ever did. LIGHT the flashlight BEFORE you need it, not after!"

l5.text: Grady, distant now: "And if it's going badly — FLEE. No shame in it. Dead men don't come back and spend."

l6.text: Grady, barely audible: "Green line on your map is the GPS — hit AUTO and let your feet follow it east. Go on! Two credits won’t earn themselves!"

name: Grady's Crash Course
